label: Quotient Home (new session)
description: Quotient's new-session home screen: the logo orb, the 'What should we create today?' hero line, the big composer card (attach clip, model pill, mic, send orb) and the category chip rows (Campaigns, Events, Content & SEO...). Use for 'the ask' beats: the user arrives in Quotient and types what they want. Chromeless -- pair with quotient-app-shell when nav chrome is wanted. Script it: type-message types the ask character by character (placeholder hides, send orb goes active), send-message presses the orb -- cut on the click.

heading.label: Hero line (default 'What should we create today?')

chips.label: Category chips: {label, icon: megaphone|calendar|pen|share|search|trend|rocket}. Defaults to Quotient's seven.

script.label: Timed actions: type-message {text, at, speed}, send-message {at}, highlight-chip {label, at}.
